notable_anecdotes.description: First ASC infusion on Sept. 1, 2013 at Medical City -- overnight stay as a precaution against complications/allergies. Dr. Denise Lavilles intravenously administered 20 million of each of four cell types (80 million total): mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) for general wellness, endothelial progenitor cells (EPC) for blood-cell repair, osteoblasts (OS) for bone repair, and chondroblasts (CH) for cartilage repair. The only incident: a male nurse failed at initial needle insertion, leaving a 'bubbled and busted vein.'
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Baseline first-infusion documentation establishing dosage and cell-type catalog.

notable_anecdotes.description: Subsequent five infusions (Sept. 20, Oct. 25, Nov. 23, Dec. 20, 2013, and Jan. 23, 2014) were all 'uneventful' / 'a non-event.' Starting with the second infusion, dosage rose to 100 million cells with a shifted ratio (35% EPC, 15% MSC, 25% OS, 25% CH). After the fifth infusion, CJ visited the 'very clean and impressive laboratory.' After the sixth and final infusion, CJ reported improvements to Dr. Lavilles: improved physical prowess, more supple hair, fewer facial lines -- with the unusual asymmetry that left-face lines almost disappeared while right-face lines remained.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Empirical results recital across the six-month treatment arc.

notable_anecdotes.description: Concurrent ailments during and after the infusions, treated by specialist team: mandibular inflammation (Dr. Nathaniel Yan), elevated PSA of 8.96 with two biopsies showing no cancer (Dr. Nikki Magsanoc), knee degeneration 'normal for my age' with advice to avoid heavy lifting (Dr. Antonio Rivera), sleep problems treated with Rivotril and melatonin (Dr. Deborah Arce Bernardo). CJ noted he 'did not think of my stem cell therapy to heal these ailments.'
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Honest framing of what the ASC was NOT expected to treat.

notable_anecdotes.description: Failed 2019 repeat: COVID-19 intervened; after the pandemic, Dr. Bernal was no longer reachable by text; Dr. Lavilles offered to conduct the repeat but only with cancer-doctor clearance -- which the cancer doctor refused because he did not believe in stem-cell science.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Documents the multi-factor reason CJ pivoted from ASC to LCT.

notable_anecdotes.description: An unnamed retired justice ('RJ,' anonymized for privacy) recommended LCT in Lenggries, Germany under Dr. Siegfried Block; RJ shared that his/her own preserved cells at Dr. Bernal's lab might also have been lost. CJ's prostate doctor Dr. Dennis Serrano consented because some of his patients had been healed by stem-cell treatment. RJ provided two books by Dr. Block -- 'Miracle Cells' and 'Stay Young and Remain Healthy' -- covering celebrity LCT patients including Pope Pius XII, Charles de Gaulle, Dwight Eisenhower, and Winston Churchill.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Peer-and-expert chain of trust narrative leading into the LCT decision.

one_paragraph_summary: Part 2 of CJ Panganiban's stem-cell series recounts his autologous stem cell (ASC) infusion experience from Sept. 1, 2013 through Jan. 23, 2014 -- six monthly intravenous infusions at the Medical City, administered by Dr. Denise Lavilles. The first infusion (Sept. 1, 2013) involved an overnight precautionary stay and the IV administration of 20 million of each of four cell types (80 million total): mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) for general wellness, endothelial progenitor cells (EPC) for blood-cell repair, osteoblasts (OS) for bone repair, and chondroblasts (CH) for cartilage repair -- with the only incident a male nurse's failed initial needle insertion producing 'a bubbled and busted vein.' Dr. Bernal explained in CJ's hospital room that after a 'huge debate among local doctors,' Philippine regulators approved only autologous treatment and banned foreign-body injections like 'sheep parts,' and that autologous subgroups (fat, blood) were either ineffective or unsanitary. The remaining five infusions on Sept. 20, Oct. 25, Nov. 23, Dec. 20, 2013, and Jan. 23, 2014 were uneventful, with dosage rising to 100 million cells and ratios shifted (35% EPC, 15% MSC, 25% OS, 25% CH); after the sixth, CJ reported improved physical prowess, more supple hair, and fewer facial lines -- though with the asymmetric outcome that the left face appeared younger than the right. Concurrent ailments (mandibular inflammation under Dr. Nathaniel Yan, elevated PSA of 8.96 with two no-cancer biopsies under Dr. Nikki Magsanoc, age-appropriate knee degeneration under Dr. Antonio Rivera, sleep problems treated by Dr. Deborah Arce Bernardo with Rivotril and melatonin) were handled separately. A planned 2019 repeat ASC was frustrated by COVID-19, Dr. Bernal's subsequent unreachability, possible loss of stored cells, and CJ's cancer doctor's refusal of clearance because he did not believe in stem-cell science. An unnamed retired justice ('RJ') redirected CJ to LCT under Dr. Siegfried Block in Lenggries, Germany; CJ read Block's books 'Miracle Cells' and 'Stay Young and Remain Healthy' on celebrity LCT patients (Pope Pius XII, de Gaulle, Eisenhower, Churchill); prostate doctor Dr. Dennis Serrano consented; and the decision to try LCT was made.
